before.title: What backup systems should a virtual event use? | West Peek Productions
before.description: A serious virtual event should have backup speaker links, alternate host access, redundant run-of-show documents, backup recording, communication channels outside the platform, and a fallback room such as Daily when the primary stream or room path breaks.

after.title: What backup systems should a virtual event use? | West Peek Productions
